rules: Forward canonical relationship targets are never renamed or deleted by this audit.
Navigation resolves canonical target strings to their canonical identity record when an exact identity exists.
Legacy/source naming is retained as a searchable presentation alias only when an explicit identity bridge supports it.
Known equipment/accessory naming conflicts remain distinct endpoints until identity evidence authorizes a merge.
result: No downstream reverse-index repair is required for the current canonical endpoints. The two known naming conflicts are explicitly resolvable to separate canonical records; the bridge prevents presentation-layer normalization from silently changing canonical relationships.
next_action: Extend the same identity-resolution audit to skill, Super Soul, character, and DLC page/index navigation, then add automated validation that every canonical relationship endpoint either resolves exactly or is listed as an explicit conflict.
